result.stdout: Nethereum MainnetChain Server v7.1.0 Read-only Ethereum mainnet follower: syncs, validates, and serves mainnet over JSON-RPC. USAGE: nethereum-mainnetchain [OPTIONS] SERVER: -p, --port JSON-RPC port (default: 8545) --host Host to bind to (default: 127.0.0.1) -v, --verbose Verbose logging --metrics-port Expose Prometheus /metrics on this port (default: off) SYNC: -d, --data-dir Chain data directory (default: ./mainnet-data) --no-snap Skip snap sync (snap is the default; a full sync is impractical for mainnet) --trusted-peer Pinned enode:// peer to always dial --listen-port Also serve snap/eth to other peers (default: off) CONSENSUS: --beacon Beacon REST endpoint (enables the light-client gate) --allow-unverified-consensus Start WITHOUT a beacon (no consensus verification; NOT recommended for mainnet) --engine Serve the Engine API so a consensus client (Lighthouse) drives the follower; excludes --beacon --genesis Custom chain: a geth-format genesis.json (chain id, fork schedule, alloc). Needs --engine; runs with no peers, no snap and no light client, and serves debug_setHead when --MainnetChain:RpcModules includes debug --engine-port Engine API port (default: 8551) --engine-jwt-secret JWT secret file shared with the consensus client (default: /jwt.hex, created if missing) MAINTENANCE: --wipe-state One-shot: clear state, keeping the block archive, then exit; the next start re-runs the state sync --rebuild-state-from-flat One-shot: rebuild stale storage-trie nodes from flat state, then verify --verify-flat One-shot: write-free flat/trie verify at the committed head, logs the full breakdown, then stops --verify-flat-sample With --verify-flat: verify only the first N accounts per shard (0 = full walk, default) --node-key-file
